description: This file provides utility functions for managing file storage across local filesystem, AWS S3, and Google Cloud Storage, including uploading, downloading, listing, and deleting files and folders, with support for fallback mechanisms and size calculations.

methods.name: dirSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of a directory recursively.

methods.name: addBase64FilesToStorage
methods.description: Uploads a base64-encoded file to storage (local, S3, or GCS), with validation and fallback handling.

methods.name: addArrayFilesToStorage
methods.description: Uploads multiple files with specified MIME type and paths to storage.

methods.name: addSingleFileToStorage
methods.description: Uploads a single file buffer to storage with specified paths.

methods.name: getFileFromUpload
methods.description: Retrieves a file buffer from storage by file path.

methods.name: getFileFromStorage
methods.description: Retrieves a file buffer from storage, with fallback to copy from alternative location if not found.

methods.name: getFilesListFromStorage
methods.description: Lists files in a storage directory or prefix.

methods.name: _deleteLocalFolderRecursive
methods.description: Recursively deletes a local directory and its contents.

methods.name: _deleteS3Folder
methods.description: Recursively deletes an S3 folder and its contents.

methods.name: getGCSStorageSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of files in a GCS bucket with a specific prefix.

methods.name: getGcsClient
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Google Cloud Storage client and bucket.

methods.name: getS3StorageSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of objects in an S3 bucket with a specific prefix.

methods.name: getS3Config
methods.description: Returns configured S3 client and bucket based on environment variables.

methods.name: _sanitizeFilename
methods.description: Sanitizes filename by removing leading dots and unsafe characters.
